0022600227.text: The Philadelphia 76ers host the Toronto Raptors with the 76ers at 9-2, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, riding a W1 streak after an 8-2 stretch over their last ten games. Toronto is 5-5, sixth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, and has lost its last game; the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the 76ers won the last meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (out, groin soreness).
